title: Hong Kong 100 – World Trail Majors listing (2027)
claims: The page lists the Hong Kong 100 Ultra Marathon as a World Trail Majors event on 21-24 January 2027.
The page describes the Hong Kong 100 Ultra Marathon as a 100-kilometer race in a megacity of 7.4 million inhabitants.
The World Trail Majors calendar on the page lists the Hong Kong 100 as its first event of the 2027 sequence shown.
